basis: source tree at commit 3dc8501242bc8951d98ef293cb683324fa58e4ca (default branch, 2026-10-02; pubspec version 2.0.2+17) + docs https://github.com/iakmds/librecamera/blob/3dc8501242bc8951d98ef293cb683324fa58e4ca/README.md and fastlane en-US store listing

features.name: Take picture
features.what: Shutter button in picture mode

features.name: Start / stop recording video
features.what: Shutter becomes record/stop in video mode

features.name: Pause / resume video
features.what: Pauses and resumes an ongoing recording
features.match_note: no pause/resume while recording

features.name: Picture mode
features.what: Still capture mode

features.name: Video recording mode
features.what: Video capture mode (with or without audio)

features.name: Switch to picture / video recording mode
features.what: Top-bar icon toggling between picture and video mode

features.name: Flip to front / rear camera
features.what: Switches between rear and front camera (works while recording, per README roadmap 1.7.0)
features.match_note: switching cameras during a recording not supported/verified; switch restarts the camera

features.name: Flashlight
features.what: Cycles flash: photo Off > On at capture > Auto > Always on (torch); video Off <> torch; rear camera only

features.name: Timer
features.what: Photo capture delay: Off, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 30 s, with on-screen countdown

features.name: Resolution
features.what: Top-bar dropdown of presets: LOW ~240p, MEDIUM ~480p, HIGH ~720p, VERY HIGH ~1080p, ULTRA HIGH ~2160p, MAX
features.match_note: video via setting:VIDEO_PROFILES

features.name: Settings button
features.what: Opens the settings page from the camera top bar

features.name: Open captured picture or video
features.what: Thumbnail of the last capture; tap opens it in an external viewer/gallery (no built-in gallery)
features.match_note: gallery button opens GlassCam's own viewer

features.name: Tap to focus / expose
features.what: Tap on the viewfinder sets focus point and exposure point; a circle marks the spot
features.match_note: touch on the preview sets focus and metering area (FocusImageHandler); no census entry

features.name: Pinch to zoom
features.what: Two-finger zoom on the preview; briefly reveals the zoom slider
features.match_note: zoom only through the manual-strip slider; no gesture zoom on the preview

features.name: Zoom slider
features.what: On-screen zoom slider with a Reset button (shown permanently if enabled in settings)

features.name: Exposure slider
features.what: Manual exposure compensation slider with reset to default exposure (when enabled)

features.name: Exposure mode
features.what: Mode-row control: AUTO EXPOSURE or LOCKED EXPOSURE (when mode row enabled)

features.name: Focus mode
features.what: Mode-row control: AUTO FOCUS or LOCKED FOCUS (when mode row enabled)

features.name: Landscape layout / rotating controls
features.what: Controls rotate and relayout for landscape (unless orientation is locked)
features.match_note: landscape layout only; controls do not rotate or relayout

features.name: Language
features.what: Choose app language or System language
features.match_note: no in-app language choice; follows the system

features.name: Theme
features.what: System, Light, Dark or Black (AMOLED) theme
features.match_note: no light/dark or colour theme choice (only the red night overlay)

features.name: Maximum screen brightness
features.what: Sets device screen brightness to maximum while in the app
features.match_note: no screen-brightness control

features.name: Left-handed mode
features.what: Swaps the position of camera controls in landscape
features.match_note: no left-handed layout

features.name: Enable focus and exposure mode row
features.what: Shows a bottom row for switching focus and exposure modes
features.match_note: focus/AE controls are always in the column; only all-or-nothing Hide camera UI

features.name: Enable zoom slider
features.what: Keeps the zoom slider permanently visible
features.match_note: zoom strip is shown when selected in the manual area; no always-visible option

features.name: Enable exposure slider
features.what: Shows the manual exposure slider
features.match_note: EV strip shown when selected in the manual area; no visibility setting

features.name: Resolution
features.what: Same resolution preset dropdown as on the camera screen

features.name: Capture at volume press
features.what: Volume buttons take a picture or start/stop video
features.match_note: volume keys step the active manual control; only the camera key / headset hook fire the shutter (KeyPressedController, no census entry)

features.name: Enable shutter sound
features.what: Plays shutter / start-recording sound

features.name: Start with front camera
features.what: Always open with the front camera
features.match_note: reopens with the last-used camera (SettingsManager.GetCurrentCamera); no fixed startup camera

features.name: Video frame rate
features.what: 24, 25, 30, 60 or 120 fps (high rates device/resolution dependent)

features.name: Disable audio
features.what: Record video without sound
features.match_note: audio on/off is stored per video profile in the profile editor; no quick switch

features.name: Flip photos on front camera
features.what: Horizontally flip selfies on save
features.match_note: no option to mirror front-camera photos

features.name: Save EXIF data
features.what: Keep EXIF metadata (model, GPS, etc.); off by default for privacy
features.match_note: EXIF is always written; only geotagging can be turned off

features.name: Save path
features.what: Choose the folder captures are saved to

features.name: Enable compression
features.what: Re-compress saved images to save storage

features.name: Image compression quality
features.what: Slider 10-100 (shown when compression enabled)

features.name: Image compression format
features.what: JPEG/JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC (shown when compression enabled)
features.match_note: JPEG and RAW/DNG only; no PNG, WebP or HEIC

features.name: Use Material You
features.what: Material You (M3) design vs old Material design
features.match_note: no light/dark or colour theme choice (only the red night overlay)

features.name: Lock auto orientation
features.what: Lock capture/UI to portrait regardless of auto-rotate (restart required)
features.match_note: always locked to landscape; no choice

features.name: Onboarding screen
features.what: Re-opens the initial onboarding flow
features.match_note: help overlay only; no onboarding flow

features.name: About
features.what: Version, GPLv3 licence, open-source licences, GitHub link
features.match_note: no About screen in the census

features.name: Onboarding: welcome, permissions, save path
features.what: First-run pages: welcome, grant camera and storage permission, choose save path
features.match_note: help overlay only; no first-run onboarding or save-path step

features.name: Quick Settings tile
features.what: QS tile that launches the camera from the notification shade
features.match_note: no Quick Settings tile

features.name: Camera intents (declared)
features.what: Manifest registers IMAGE_CAPTURE(_SECURE), STILL_IMAGE_CAMERA(_SECURE), VIDEO_CAMERA, VIDEO_CAPTURE so it can be picked as the camera app; no Dart code found that returns a result/EXTRA_OUTPUT to the caller
features.match_note: IMAGE_CAPTURE(_SECURE) and STILL_IMAGE_CAMERA(_SECURE) handled (and results returned); VIDEO_CAMERA / VIDEO_CAPTURE not

notes: No home-screen widget and no built-in gallery. A QR scanner exists only as commented-out code (roadmap item), not as a feature. Repo README/About still link github.com/iakdis/librecamera; the clone was made from github.com/iakmds/librecamera as given.
